def f(g):
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)

    box=max((c for c in cnt if c!=bg),key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    rs=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==box]; cs=[j for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==box]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cells=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1) if g[i][j]!=box and g[i][j]!=bg]

    for (i,j,v) in cells:

        nc = int(c1+1) if j < mid_c else int(c0-1)
        out[nr][nc]=v
        out[i][j]=bg
    return out
